notes: Three steps, in order: Plan draws the rooms, Wiring fills one with points and circuits, Panel builds the board. The top switch moves between them.
New floor plan: every room of the project seen from above, with walls, doors, windows and the names, sizes and areas.
Drag a room to move it — pushed up against a neighbour it snaps so the two share one wall instead of ending up with two.
Drag the handle on a wall to resize a room, Rotate for a quarter turn, and drag a door or window along its wall or round a corner onto the next one.
Add rooms, doors and windows from the + library, and tap “Wire this room →” to carry straight on to the wiring.
Dimensions, Points and Cables can each be turned off, and the whole plan exports as a PNG or SVG drawing.
Fixed: duplicating a room no longer forgets which circuit each point was on.
